leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures
Configure retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures
Construct a fallback mechanism to maintain partial functionality during outages
Apply health check endpoints to monitor system component availability
Initialize a bulkhead pattern to isolate failures within system boundaries
Integrate timeout controls to prevent resource exhaustion from hanging requests
Manipulate load balancer configurations to route traffic away from failing nodes
